title: Sacrosanct Awareness
tagline: Make your character feel more like a vampire
description: Makes a Sacrosanct vampire player character aware of their condition: how hungry they are and when they last fed, in their own thoughts and lines, with private thoughts as hunger worsens, on feeding and embracing, when the Beast takes over, and on Vampire Lord transformations. Others only notice at Blood Starved, the stage Sacrosanct makes public.
author: min
changelog:
1.1.0: Routine thoughts (feeds, hunger stages, sunlight, Vampire Lord) roll between several angles so they stop repeating
1.0.0: Initial release
